title: Add planning record serialization compatibility
description: Implement planning-record JSON serialization and validation using the complete post-grouping, post-reusable task metadata payload: identity, title/description, priority, estimate, lane, model, origin, assignee, dependencies, comments, issueId, project, milestone, version, featureId, feature, reusableTaskIds, and timestamps. Preserve current JSON field names and omitempty behavior, require canonical IDs and valid metadata, and prohibit execution lifecycle timestamps. Add deterministic round-trip fixtures, Unicode and multiline content, empty optional fields, populated reusable assignments, unknown/malformed status rejection, and compatibility coverage showing existing executable task JSON remains byte-contract compatible.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Progress: inspected the complete PlanningItem/Task parity contract and existing reusablejson strict codec. Implementing an additive planningjson codec with core validation, strict unknown/duplicate handling, nil lifecycle enforcement, and deterministic fixture coverage while preserving executable Task JSON behavior.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Completed planning-record serialization compatibility. Added core.PlanningItem.Validate using shared executable metadata rules plus fixed planning lifecycle validation; added internal/planningjson strict deterministic codec with complete Task-parity fields/tags, canonical IDs, metadata checks, explicit null lifecycle timestamps, UTF-8 validation, duplicate/unknown rejection, nested comment validation, and file helpers. Fixtures cover full Unicode/multiline round trips, ordered reusableTaskIds, empty optional omission/required arrays, malformed/unknown execution/planning statuses, lifecycle timestamp rejection, canonical-ID/metadata failures, and executable Task JSON byte compatibility. PASS; go test -race ./internal/core ./internal/planningjson -count=1 PASS; ./scripts/verify.sh commit PASS (full tests, vet, smoke, commit verification); git diff --check PASS with only the pre-existing e2e_smoke.ps1 LF/CRLF warning. Unrelated dirty worktree changes preserved; no other task or worker modified.
